# Mousa Batarseh

> Webmaster in Warren, Michigan. Seven years building and running WordPress websites and e-commerce stores (WooCommerce, Shopify) — catalogs, product data, promotions, SEO and the browser tools that check them. English and Arabic.

## Pages
- [Home](https://mousabatarseh.com/): who he is, how he thinks (sheet / register / shelf), selected sites and stores, the tools he built, independent reviews.
- [All the work](https://mousabatarseh.com/work/): the complete archive — tools, case studies, websites, stores, reviews and proposals, each linked to its case study or live site.
- [About](https://mousabatarseh.com/about/): method, services, skills, tools, courses.
- [Reviews](https://mousabatarseh.com/reviews/): independent website reviews; every finding dated and sourced.
- [Notes](https://mousabatarseh.com/blog): articles on catalogs, migrations, SEO and store operations.
